# Changelog

<!-- Generated by scripts/release-history.py from releases/history.json. -->

Every published companion build has an entry below. Android packages are laboratory builds; iOS packages require Apple signing and provisioning. Historical validation belongs to the named version and does not establish current physical-device performance.

## [0.2.7](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.7): build 9 · 2026-11-01

**Current-network QR pairing and the approved 3D emblem** · experimental-prerelease

- Use the approved blue three-dimensional showcase emblem in Android/iOS launcher icons and native headers, the GitHub README and HarmonyOS source assets. Keep the simplified mark for small monochrome system surfaces.
- The host follows its current private IPv4 route when creating a pairing QR, validates the local bind and retires stale invitations after a network move. Per-address TLS identities preserve certificate and hostname verification; companions scan a fresh QR after an address change. Enrollment and measurement history remain available.
- Android routes paired-host requests through a matching connected Wi-Fi/Ethernet network when available, retaining system routing for tethering. Network timeouts and TLS identity failures have distinct localized guidance. Exported diagnostics include only allowlisted route events and available transport categories.
- Desktop graph links use color and width for measured accepted draft token share. Selected running draft routes animate; completed, offline, unknown and fallback routes stay still. A motion toggle, background pause and reduced-motion support are included.
- Publish a pinned Locally Uncensored source assessment with attribution and clear boundaries between independently implemented diagnostics and future planner/cancellation requirements.

**Validation:** Android compilation, 13 JVM tests and lint (0 errors, 19 warnings), unsigned iOS ARM64 device build, 24 host protocol/network tests, localization and graph accounting checks passed. Browser fixture verified weighted animation and the motion toggle using explicitly synthetic data. Android signer continuity, packaged artwork, unchanged native LLM libraries and identical ZIP/IPA app payloads were verified. Physical-device reconnection and installation remain unconfirmed.

**Limits:** No physical Oppo/Xiaomi installation or camera qualification in this build. Token share is not compute utilization or a speedup. iOS packages require Apple signing. HarmonyOS/NEXT source artwork is updated but native builds remain deferred. Native LLM libraries are reused; no engine performance claim.

## [0.2.6](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.6): build 8 · 2026-11-01

**Reliable controls, local diagnostics and automatic update checks** · experimental-prerelease

- Replace the Android legacy scanner activity with lifecycle-bound CameraX, an offline ZXing decoder, retry/cancel controls and a camera-open timeout. Permission denial and camera errors return actionable feedback; invitation validation and identity confirmation remain required.
- Android controls distinguish available, disabled, pressed, selected and busy states. Session status, engine permission and actual draft readiness are separate; saved engine permission is synchronized after service changes.
- Desktop actions show request progress across polling updates and block duplicate submissions. Narrow-screen Add device labels and QR spacing are repaired. iOS controls gain explicit pressed/disabled styling and connection progress.
- English, Simplified Chinese and Italian messages, Android APK and unsigned iOS packages share version 0.2.6/build 8. Native LLM libraries are reused without engine changes.
- Add bounded local Android/iOS diagnostic journals with explicit export and clear, sanitized managed exception context, supported Android process exit reasons and reduced iOS MetricKit events. Previous interruption markers do not establish a crash cause.
- Check official companion release metadata at launch and weekly while running, with due checks after OS suspension, offline retry and an explicit Check now action. Installation remains manual.
- Use the current original orbital NodeLift mark in native headers and launcher icons. Add project acknowledgements and preserve original third-party licenses and source.

**Validation:** Android app/instrumentation compilation and lint, ten JVM QR/support policy tests, unsigned iOS device compilation, Swift journal/update checks, 19 host protocol tests, localization and focused desktop control tests passed. Android signing continuity and unchanged native libraries were verified. Actual external source/design reviews are scoped in release evidence. Physical scanning, sharing and weekly scheduling on a phone were not tested.

**Limits:** The reported Xiaomi crash remains unconfirmed without a device log; install and exercise the new APK. Logs are best effort and cannot capture every native crash. OS suspension delays checks until execution resumes. iOS packages require Apple signing; TestFlight/App Store distribution is planned, not available. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds remain deferred. No new inference speedup or pooled-RAM result.

## [0.2.5](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.5): build 7 · 2026-11-01

**Desktop QR pairing and native mobile scanning** · experimental-prerelease

- Add device on the desktop displays an offline QR; Android and iOS companions scan it and request address/fingerprint confirmation. Manual invitation import remains available.
- Five-minute, single-use invitations expire, clear after use and are revoked when explicitly closed. Camera access is requested only for scanning; pairing does not enable inference automatically.
- Android retains the existing debug signer and saved pairings, with an explicit host leaf-certificate pin. Update and restart the desktop host to use the new pairing flow.
- Android ARM64 APK, unsigned iOS IPA/app ZIP and SHA-256 manifests are published. Native engine libraries are unchanged from 0.2.4.

**Validation:** Android and unsigned iOS device compilation, host protocol and desktop lifecycle checks, Swift parsing and loopback TLS tests passed. Independent ZXing decoding recovered the QR from a desktop screenshot. Published package hashes were verified.

**Limits:** Physical Android/iOS camera scanning remains unqualified. iOS requires personal Apple signing/provisioning and cannot install directly from Safari. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds are deferred. No inference speedup or RAM-pooling claim.

## [0.2.4](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.4): build 6 · 2026-11-01

**About, references and manual release discovery** · experimental-prerelease

- Desktop and companions expose authorship, installed version/build, official project links, technical references, licenses and the official GitHub release list.
- Update discovery is manual; no silent update check or installation. Installed Android/iOS versions replace hardcoded telemetry values.
- Host 0.3.0 preview metadata is separate from companion 0.2.4. Android signer and native libraries match 0.2.3; iOS IPA and ZIP contain the same unsigned app.

**Validation:** 717-key catalog parity, JavaScript/Swift formatters, graph checks, 16 focused host protocol tests and desktop browser checks passed. GLM 5.3 Max reviewed selected About source; no Gemini review for this change.

**Limits:** No physical Android/iPhone installation or UI qualification. Native HarmonyOS/NEXT remains uncompiled without a HAP or native LLM worker. No new native-engine performance result.

## [0.2.3](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.3): build 5 · 2026-11-01

**Italian UI and host integration preview** · experimental-prerelease

- Italian joins default English and Simplified Chinese; 557 shared messages cover pairing, diagnostics and model/provider controls. Saved choices persist and prompts/model output are not translated.
- Tagged host source includes the 0.3.0 integration preview: public Hugging Face GGUF search/download, direct import, explicit OpenRouter and loopback local-server routes.
- Supplementary unsigned IPA packaging was published on 1 November with a byte-identical app payload and a separate manifest; original build artifacts were unchanged.

**Validation:** Catalog/placeholder/freshness, JavaScript/Swift formatter and live browser checks passed. Android app/instrumentation APKs and unsigned iOS device app compiled; native binaries match 0.2.2.

**Limits:** Physical mobile UI and Android instrumentation execution remain unverified; no ADB device was available. No new GLM/Gemini review for Italian. iOS requires signing; no HarmonyOS HAP or new speed benchmark.

## [0.2.2](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.2): build 4 · 2026-10-31

**Default English and Simplified Chinese localization** · experimental-prerelease

- Desktop and companions start in English, offer Simplified Chinese and retain an explicit offline language choice across sessions; initial catalog contains 440 shared entries.
- Language switching preserves user content and unapplied settings; the API-key panel clears sensitive access data.
- Tagged source includes the earlier measured adaptive-control/context-lookup work. Packaged native binaries are unchanged from 0.2.1.

**Validation:** 40 host tests, localization/formatting checks and live browser checks passed. Android and unsigned iOS builds compiled. GLM 5.3 Max reviewed 15 terminology entries; Gemini High was usage-limited.

**Limits:** Physical localization and sustained active-node switching remain unverified. Android instrumentation did not execute because the emulator stayed offline. No physical-phone acceleration or pooled RAM established.

## [0.2.1](https://github.com/sev7enITA/NodeLift/releases/tag/v0.2.1): build 3 · 2026-10-31

**Native inference and authenticated mobile draft workers** · experimental-prerelease

- Pinned llama.cpp core, greedy block verification, correction/bonus tokens, KV resynchronization, identity checks, pinned TLS leases and bounded remote fallback.
- Android ARM64 CPU and iOS Metal/CPU workers, model integrity and battery/thermal/lifecycle controls; authenticated text/SSE gateway and LM Studio generator adapter.
- Actual Gemini 4 High and GLM 5.3 Max design/source reviews were adjudicated. The frozen small-pair local-draft block-4 control reached 0.719× host-only speed, with all 48 paired token sequences matching.

**Validation:** 26 host tests, 29 real-weight native checks, four real-weight TLS loopback fault cases, live gateway checks and three adapter stream tests passed. Android and unsigned iOS device builds compiled.

**Limits:** The remote test node was emulated. Physical-phone inference/speedup, sustained thermals, capacity sharding, hybrid speculative checkpoints, HarmonyOS native worker and installed LM Studio GUI qualification remained open. The 27B upstream kernel result is not NodeLift hybrid-model support.

## Documentation and tooling updates

### 2026-11-01: Network recovery guides and unused legacy icon fallback

- Update installation/QR support guides for automatic current-network invitations without resetting state.
- Replace the unused pre-API-26 legacy drawable in source after 0.2.7 publication. Supported Android versions (API 26+) use the approved 3D adaptive launcher in the published APK. Original 0.2.7 binaries and source tag remain unchanged.

### 2026-11-01: Project acknowledgements and editorial consistency

- Add a dedicated showcase Credits chapter and repository acknowledgements with direct links to DistAI and other studied projects, actual dependencies, integration providers and all 54 external comparison entries.
- Name contributors and distinguish incorporated software from research references. Preserve original licenses, source snapshots, benchmark records and archived reviewer text.
- Remove em dashes from NodeLift-authored prose and UI placeholders, including release-history generation, while preserving verbatim third-party evidence.

### 2026-11-01: English documentation and synchronized release history

- Repository guides, historical assessments and research dossiers are maintained in English; application/showcase localization remains English, Simplified Chinese and Italian.
- One versioned history generates the repository changelog, portal downloadable notes and rendered release notes. Build and CI checks reject missing build entries or stale generated history.
- Wiki, how-to hub, gallery, diagnostics, release-integrity workflow and REA source study document implemented behavior and qualification limits. No mobile binary is rebuilt for this documentation update.

Publication dates are UTC. Companion versions and the host preview version are separate. Original published binaries and tags are not rewritten for documentation corrections.
